name: Res Arcana

categories.label: Artifacts
categories.help: Points printed on the artifacts you have placed, including any on turned (tapped) ones.

categories.label: Monuments
categories.help: Points from the monuments you have claimed.

categories.label: Places of Power
categories.help: Points from the Places of Power you have claimed, including points they award for essences or other conditions.

categories.label: First Player token
categories.help: Tick if you hold the First Player token when victory is checked; it is worth 1 point.

categories.label: Essences in pool
categories.help: Essences in your pool, counting each Gold as two; the most breaks a tie among leaders.

notes: Victory is checked at the end of each round; the game ends once at least one player has 10 or more points, and a total below 10 cannot win. Enter totals at that check. Read from a retailer-CDN mirror of the publisher PDF (page 1 cover was OCR; the body text was extractable). Temporary points such as the Golden Statue react power are counted if used at the check. Draft variants, the two-game match format and expansions are excluded.
